aboutGame.title: What is World of Anterra?
paragraphs: World of Anterra is a handcrafted pixel-art open-world RPG from 81monkeys, planned for PC via Steam in 2026. Its world spans continents, oceans, mountains, caves, and dungeons, with NPCs who work, socialize, eat, and pursue routines of their own.

The adventure combines a non-linear story and branching quests with grid-based party combat, quick-time attacks and defense, typed dialogue questions, and activities such as camping, crafting, building, gathering, and fishing. Progress comes through party composition, visible gear, spells, crafted items, and exploration rather than a single linear path.

modules.name: World of Anterra Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start with optional tutorials, gather early food and materials, test combat safely, and build habits that carry through the first dungeon.

highlights.detail: Follow the first tutorial prompt, then test skipping the next to learn how optional guidance works.
Pick up berries, trim bushes, and check containers around the starting area before moving inward.
Walk the outer edge of the starting zone to learn where safe ground ends.
Practice movement, dodge, and stamina away from enemies so the controls feel natural.
Take one easy fight and one risky fight to calibrate damage, retreat timing, and consumable value.
Open every menu, memorize three landmarks, and rest before entering caves or crypts.

items.question: What is World of Anterra?
items.answer: World of Anterra is a handcrafted pixel-art open-world RPG from 81monkeys. It combines a non-linear story, branching quests, grid-based party combat with quick-time actions, typed dialogue questions, and activities such as camping, crafting, building, gathering, and fishing.

items.question: When is the World of Anterra release date?
items.answer: The World of Anterra Steam page lists a 2026 release window. Wishlist and follow the official store page for the firm launch date and any demo announcements.

items.question: Which platforms will World of Anterra support?
items.answer: PC via Steam is the confirmed World of Anterra storefront. The developer is also targeting desktop and console releases, with backers choosing their preferred platform.

items.question: How does combat work in World of Anterra?
items.answer: World of Anterra combat uses a grid for positioning and quick-time inputs for attacks and defense. Harder fights reward weakness exploitation, environmental hazards, rare consumables, and a party built around clear roles.

items.question: Does World of Anterra have co-op?
items.answer: Online co-op is planned alongside the World of Anterra single-player campaign. Follow official Steam news and developer firesides for mode details, player counts, and launch timing.
